- Objective: 6-week POC to validate Redwood inference latency and cost for the eMR summarization use case.
- Primary success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 220ms, token cost target <$0.0009, integration with S3 export.
- Stakeholders you named: yourself (internal sponsor / product), Lara Nguyen (security), procurement inbox for contracting.

1) Action: Internal gap analysis (we did a quick one live) — Jonas to finalize MAP and share.
2) Security evidence: SOC2 summary + network requirements — attached SOC2_summary.pdf.
3) Procurement: rough timeline and templates — please share your procurement sequence; I added a column in the MAP for typical documents and owners.

Proposed milestones (week numbers from kick):
- Week 0: NDA / SOW template exchange (procurement)
- Week 1: Technical onboarding + test dataset delivery
- Week 2–3: Run validation workloads, telemetry review
- Week 4: Security review + evidence exchange
- Week 5–6: Final evaluation & decision

Can you confirm:
- The procurement contact who will own the SOW/PO (you mentioned a central inbox)
- Security review window (Lara, did you have 2 weeks available mid-September?)

Attachments: 20270901-MAP-draft.xlsx (MAP draft), SOC2_summary.pdf (Redwood SOC2 overview)

Thanks — I captured everything into the attached MAP draft and left task owners blank for you to assign. If this looks right I can flip the map to a shared Drive doc and add granular dates.
